data.title: 贝尔法斯特 · 花瓶里的海风
data.description: 早晨的海风吹动窗帘，贝尔法斯特扶住窗边的花瓶，将一枝偏斜的白花重新摆正。
data.promptProse: Along the bright seaside corridor in the morning, Belfast stands beside an open casement window in her crisp black-and-white royal maid dress. She steadies a slender ceramic vase on the sunlit windowsill with one hand and gently straightens a tilted white flower stem with the other as sea air lifts the sheer white curtain beside her. Clear morning light streams across the petals, her crisp white apron, and the polished wooden sill.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the open corridor window in her maid uniform, Belfast steadies the ceramic vase on the sill with one hand and adjusts a tilted white bloom with the other. Morning sunlight and a gentle sea breeze lift the sheer curtain behind her.
